subject: math
description: Use the intersecting chords theorem to solve for missing segment lengths inside circles.
learningObjectives: Identify the two segment lengths formed on each chord when chords intersect inside a circle
State and use the intersecting chords theorem
Set up equations of the form segment times segment equals segment times segment
Solve for missing segment lengths in intersecting chord diagrams
Check whether a computed length is reasonable in the context of the diagram
prerequisites: Understanding that segment lengths are positive
